source.claim: The legacy patch contains 24 objects, 27 nets, and the complete Gills shell.
The local object owns the public inlet, outlet, and embedded-code seam.
Main oscillator and granular engine structures are declared here.
Instrument control, effects, allocation, processing, and OLED behavior are declared here.
LED stage feedback and OLED text formatting are declared here.
Waveguide, sympathetic string, body, and diffusion-tail helpers are declared here.
Project-local license terms are recorded without inferring third-party file licenses.

configuration_facts: Root initializes to MIDI note 60 and the encoder is bounded from 36 through 72.
Stereo headphone output is configured at -24 dB.
The display uses narrow font with scope disabled.
